Atlassian._comment: Atlassian Remote MCP Server — OAuth-based, hosted by Atlassian/claude.ai. No local process needed. Enable via claude.ai Settings > Integrations > Atlassian. When enabled, tool prefix is 'mcp__claude_ai_Atlassian'. For a self-hosted Atlassian MCP server, replace command/args below and update mcp.atlassian.toolPrefix in support-ticket-resolver-config.json.

github._comment: Official GitHub MCP Server — runs locally via Docker or npx. Provides tools for repos, PRs, issues, and commits. When enabled, tool prefix is 'mcp__github'.
